events.body:
Send Supabase Auth email through Loops, then bring signed-up users into onboarding workflows through a separate contact-sync path. Loops is an email sending platform for SaaS teams that supports both jobs.

The Send Email Hook routes authentication email through a Supabase Edge Function to the matching Loops transactional template. It covers authentication email only; it does not sync contacts or start onboarding.

For onboarding, the contact-sync setup creates or updates Loops contacts from `auth.users` events. A workflow triggered by an `INSERT` event can then send a welcome or onboarding sequence.

Sending through Loops also requires a verified Loops sending domain. The Supabase documentation shows both paths and their setup requirements, so you can compare the architecture with your planned implementation before creating an account or changing production infrastructure.

Authentication email and onboarding do not share one Supabase connection in Loops. Loops is an email sending platform for SaaS teams that supports both jobs through independent integrations.
